title: Fake
text: “Na—Gyaaaaaaaaaaaah!”

The Hero of the Claws was struck by a sudden, surprise attack—an energy spear that flew straight at his face—and… alas, his head was blown right off. It seems he unwittingly borrowed a skills enhancement and unleashed a strike with a reinforced spear.

It was truly a single, decisive blow. It possessed such power that even trying to block it would have been futile… Had it been just an ordinary spear, he might have survived. It pulsates as if the Beast Spear itself were alive.
“T-The Spear Hero has lost his mind!”
“W-What should we do?!”
“Motoyasu, what on earth is going on!?”
“I don’t know either. The spear just…”
Just as I was explaining that…
“Wait!”
“Wait!”

The representative of the Shusaku clan and the elderly man from the Genmu clan called out to us. Despite this being an emergency, they remain remarkably calm. As expected of leaders. Even so, the commotion shows no signs of subsiding.

However, the representative of the Shusaku clan pointed at the corpse of the Spear Hero. Suddenly, the Claw Hero’s corpse began to change before our very eyes… transforming into a monster with numerous fox-like tails.
“Huh?”
“What on earth is this…”
“The Claw Hero has turned into the corpse of a fox monster…?”
“…It seems the Spear Hero realized the Claw Hero was an imposter. That must be why he did this.”
The elderly man of the Genmu clan muttered as he stroked his chin.
“It seems we’re the ones who were saved.”
“But what exactly is this fox monster…? Where has the real Hero of the Claws gone?”
“Well… we’ll need to investigate that. Everyone, let’s thank the Spear Hero for defeating the imposter who disguised himself as the Hero of the Claws.”
For some reason, everyone praised me. It’s always nice to be recognized for your achievements, no matter how old you get. Well, I do like being praised by Father and Filo-tan the most, though.
“Hmm?”
“That was a surprise. It seems he even managed to hide his scent.”
“Wow. How does he manage to transform so well?”
“Anyway, I’m starting to worry about the real Hero of the Claws. Is this… also because of the Wave?”
“I don’t know.”
“Ominous… What on earth is going on in this world…”
Éclair stabs the fox monster with her sword to check its condition. It seems to be completely dead. Well, with Motoyasu’s power, defeating a weakling like this is a breeze.

Hmm… But why, I wonder? Looking at this monster reminds me of Big Sister’s heroic deeds. I recall Filo-tan bragging about them. But Filo-tan’s Big Sister was supposed to be a Tanuki-like Demi-Human. It’s disrespectful to Big Sister to lump her in with a fox like this.
Eventually, the audience was temporarily suspended, and Siltvelt set out to investigate the whereabouts of the Hero of the Claws and the fox monster.
“This is… an urgent matter that must be reported at the World Conference… May I ask Miss Seaetto to accompany us?”
“H-huh… I was planning to do just that, of course.”
The Genmu and Éclair spoke up at the conference. The representative of the Shusaku clan was also nodding in agreement.
“The entire nation is mobilized to track down the Hero of the Claw, but whether we’ll find him or not…”
“This is getting rather ominous… I never imagined the Hero of the Claw would suddenly turn out to be an imposter.”
“Indeed.”
A foreboding shadow constantly lingers. I, Motoyasu, am overcome by an indescribable anxiety. But that is precisely why I must fight alongside my Father.

The world is still hurtling toward destruction. Just as my Father said, even I—who am said to be so strong—am losing. I chose the path of battle for the sake of world peace, as I promised Filo-tan, and for the future of the Filolial-sama. Therefore, my anxiety is practically nonexistent.

The only thing shining in my heart is the single ray of light that is my Father. And the hope that we will fight together and carve out a future. Even if that path leads to the very depths of hell, I will go with you.
“Therefore, Shield Hero and Spear Hero, we humbly request your participation in our nation’s Wave…”
“Yeah. That was our plan all along anyway.”
“That’s right.”
“While we’re at it, why don’t we try to find the Hero of the Claw while we’re leveling up?”

“Given the events that have transpired, I would prefer you to prepare for the Wave in a safe location, but given the circumstances… I formally request your cooperation in the search for the Claw Hero.”
“You don’t have to make it sound so complicated. Should we just assume the Claw Hero is already dead…?”
“No, he is believed to be alive. We are able to monitor the life and death of the Heroes, and the Claw Hero’s death has not been detected.”
“I see. Well, that’s a relief, at least. So, is he being held captive somewhere, then?”

My Father let out a sigh of relief upon hearing that the Claw Hero was alive. He really is a kind man. Still, a search for the Claw Hero, huh? I wonder where on earth he could be. At the very least, I don’t think I’ve ever met the Claw Hero in the previous world… or so I thought. Yes, no matter how hard I try to remember, I’ve never met the Claw Hero.
“Probably…”
“So, until our turn comes, our job is to search for the Claw Hero and level up.”
“Understood! I, Motoyasu, will find the Claw Hero just as you command, Father.”
“Count on me. I’ll learn Magic and do my best to get stronger, too.”
“In that case, I’ll have a Crystal Ball prepared so you can learn the basic spells.”
“Wouldn’t it be better to learn from books, Motoyasu-kun?”
“That’s certainly true. Learning from books makes it easier to control the intensity and helps conserve Magical Power.”
“However, I think it’s best to start by learning how to sense your Magical Power first.”
Hmm… That’s certainly true. When I, Motoyasu, learned using the Crystal Ball, that was the first time I truly felt Magical Power… the sensation of Magic.
“Then, let’s learn the first spell using the Crystal Ball, and once we have some leeway, we’ll learn it through reading and writing.”
“Sounds good.”
And so, my Father learned a little Magic, and we set out on a journey to find the Hero of the Claw.
“Well then, Spear Hero, if there’s anything you need, we’ll assist you to the best of our ability. You’ve earned our gratitude for delivering the Shield Hero safely—is there anything you’d like?”
“That’s right. I’d like some money.”
Just before we set out, I said that to the delegation from Siltvelt. Then my Father said with a complicated expression:
“Motoyasu, your very first words are about money… Is there something you want?”
“Yes, I am. I want to use the money to buy a new Filolial-sama.”
“Eh… Wouldn’t the people of Siltvelt be able to provide that much?”
My Father asked me, looking puzzled.
“Yes. If the Spear Hero desires a Filolial-sama, we’ll order as many as you like, but…”
“That won’t do.”

You see, my true goal is to become Filo-tan’s master. Right now, the situation matches the time in the first world when my Father recruited Filo-tan. In other words, my Father purchased Filo-tan from the Monster Merchant around this time… If I buy up all the Filolial-sama from the Monster Merchant right now, I’ll definitely be able to get Filo-tan. To do that, I’ll need a massive amount of money. And I plan to come up with that money.
“You decided to search for the Hero of the Claws, yet you’re going to buy Filolials… Motoyasu-kun, you really are amazing in so many ways.”
“Searching is a very arduous task. If I had plenty of reliable Filolial-sama, the work would be much easier.”
“Well… I suppose that’s one way of looking at it?”
“Well then, I, Motoyasu, will go buy some Filolial-sama for a specific reason. Yuki-chan and the others should go get their levels Class Uped by your Father while you’re gone.”
“Oh, right, that’s another thing. Got it. I’ll help Yuki-chan and the others Class Up with me today, so Motoyasu-kun, feel free to go shopping.”
“Alright then, Father, I’m leaving Yuki-chan and the others in your care.”
“Motoyasu-sama! Please come back soon!”
“Yay! We’re going out with Iwatani today—I’ve been bored, so I can finally play!”
“Sakura’s going to work hard to get stronger, too!”

After leaving Yuki-chan and the others in my Father’s care, I received a lot of money from the folks in Siltvelt. With this much, I’ll be able to get Filo-tan! Ah, I’ll be able to meet Filo-tan very soon. Just thinking about it fills my heart with hope for the future.
“Well then, I’m off to buy some Filolial-sama.”
“Have a safe trip, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Have a safe trip.”
Waving goodbye in the courtyard of Siltvelt Castle, I used my Portal Spear. My destination was… a village near the town of Melromarc!
